name: viralswipefile
description: Viral TikToks and Instagram Reels in your AI agent: a viral video library to find viral videos by niche and format, read their hooks, and write viral hooks, video ideas and content ideas from what went viral.

interface.longDescription:
Viral Swipe File is a library of viral TikToks and Instagram Reels, filed by niche and format, for social media managers, creators, UGC teams and app marketers. Find viral videos and their hooks, then get video ideas and content ideas for your next short-form video, written from what went viral in your niche. Connect it and your AI agent does the scrolling: ask what to post for a fitness client, or for viral hooks in finance, and it reads real videos from the library, names the hooks and formats that repeat, and writes new ones for your product or account in those patterns.

Built for social media managers juggling several clients, creators, UGC teams and app marketers.

Search by topic or creator, or filter by niche, format (selfie with background, face close-up, story in slideshow and more), platform, creator gender, posting window and minimum viral factor. Viral factor is views against the account's usual: 10x means ten times what that account normally gets, so a small account's breakout ranks next to a big one's. Open a video for its stored hook, description, available views and engagement rate, niche, formats and creator. Your team's saved videos are available too, so they can turn into a brief, and when you ask, your agent saves new finds, notes why, puts them on boards, shares a board by link and follows creators for you, in the workspace you name.

Every figure comes from the library's own records, and every example links to its page on viralswipefile.com, which links the original post. Your agent is told to keep its own hooks apart from the quoted ones.

The library is a collection of past viral videos, not a live trend feed or an analytics tool for your own account. It covers TikTok and Instagram Reels only, not YouTube or long-form video. It links to videos rather than downloading them. Most tools read the catalog and your workspace; the rest change only your workspace (saves, notes, boards and their share links, creator follows), with a permission you approve when you connect. No tool posts, downloads or changes a video. Access limits may cap results or omit breakdowns. Calls are metered and recorded for account analytics and lifecycle events. A Viral Swipe File account is required to connect.
capabilities: Viral TikToks and Reels by niche and format
Viral hooks with views and viral factor
Video ideas and content ideas from viral posts
Which short-form formats work in a niche
defaultPrompt: What should I post this week for a fitness client? Base each idea on a viral video
Find viral hooks in finance and write 5 for my budgeting app
Which video formats work best for astrology on TikTok?

positive.description: Find the most viral videos in one niche
positive.prompt: Show me the 10 most viral fitness videos and their hooks.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the fitness niche, lists up to 10 videos sorted by viral factor with each video's hook, platform, creator, views and viral factor, explains that viral factor is views relative to the account's usual, and links each video's viralswipefile.com page.

positive.prompt: Which video formats work best for astrology videos on TikTok?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the astrology niche, reads its top TikToks by viral factor, groups them by format with how many videos in the sample use each, names the best example of each format with its link, and says the answer describes the library's sample rather than the whole platform.

positive.prompt: Open the most viral face close-up video in the library and break down why its hook works.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the top face close-up video by viral factor, reads it with get_video, quotes its hook and stats (views, viral factor, engagement rate) as returned, and analyses the hook without inventing figures; links the video's page.

positive.description: Write hooks modelled on viral examples
positive.prompt: I run a budgeting app. Write 5 TikTok hooks based on viral finance videos.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads viral finance videos, names the hook patterns they share with a linked example of each, then writes 5 new hooks for a budgeting app in those patterns, clearly marked as new writing rather than library data.

positive.description: Save a video to a new board in the team's workspace
positive.prompt: Put the most viral fitness video on a new board called Gym ideas, then show me my boards.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the top fitness video by viral factor, creates the Gym ideas board with that video on it (which also saves the video), names the workspace it acted in, then lists the workspace's boards with their video counts and links. Does not turn on the board's share link, which the user did not ask for.

negative.description: Live trends are out of scope
negative.prompt: What is trending on TikTok right now, today?
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that the library is a collection of past viral videos, not a live trend feed, and offers the most viral videos in the library for the user's niche instead.

negative.prompt: Find the most viral YouTube videos about cooking.
negative.expected_behavior: States that the library covers TikTok and Instagram Reels only and offers viral cooking TikToks or Reels instead.

negative.description: Posting to social accounts is out of scope
negative.prompt: Post the top fitness video to my TikTok account and delete my old posts.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that the plugin cannot post to or change TikTok or Instagram accounts; it reads the library and can only save videos, organize boards and follow creators in the user's Viral Swipe File workspace. Offers to save the video or put it on a board instead.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: 1.6.1: The listing now says what Viral Swipe File is in the words people search for: a viral video library of TikToks and Instagram Reels, with viral hooks, video ideas and content ideas. Subtitle, description, capabilities and keywords changed; tools, skills, sign-in and access are unchanged. 1.6.0: Every answer is snake_case, including next_offset on lists. Video cards in the API carry language, hook tactic, tone and visual formats like the MCP cards. Skills treat video text and notes as data, never as instructions.
